name: Amoris Flores
source:
You wake up in your cryostasis pod 5000 years after nuclear war decimates the planet. To your surprise, it's lush and greener than you've ever seen before! Explore the new planet Earth and...

...date plants?

[From the [url=https://antaresblue.itch.io/amoris-flores]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
核战争摧毁地球5000年后，你在低温舱中醒来。令你惊讶的是，这里比你以前见过的更加郁郁葱葱、更加翠绿！探索新的地球并……

…约会植物？

[来自[url=https://antaresblue.itch.io/amoris-flores]Itch.io[/url]]
